angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 587,240 km at 134.89 pc = 0.06 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 7.4133 +/- 0.0282 mas (same row, RUWE 1.30): 134.89 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.8441 +/- 0.0062 solar radii from Eschen et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-4311 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.549ag952E/abstract): 587,240 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.816 +/- 0.047 solar masses from Eschen et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-4311 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.549ag952E/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5063 +/- 66 K from Eschen et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-4311 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.549ag952E/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Eschen et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-4311 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.549ag952E/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-4311.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.497, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4311 (pscomppars): spectral type K, from Eschen et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.549ag952E/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, LP 886-41: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star

luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4311 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.37469, from Eschen et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.549ag952E/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4311 (pscomppars): age 6.6 Gyr, from Eschen et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.549ag952E/abstract)
